parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the transparent surface of the clock, made of glass, covering the hands and dial.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the clock hands and dial from dust and damage while allowing visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of wood, providing structure and aesthetics.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and encloses the internal components of the clock.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, shorter and thicker than the other hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour by rotating slowly around the clock face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes by rotating around the clock face once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the second hand of the clock, made of aluminum, the thinnest and lightest of the three hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds by rotating around the clock face once every 60 seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis once every minute.
